senses.gloss: m. (פָּרַק) taking apart (of the Tabernacle), breaking up.
units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 4">Num. R. s. 4</cite> <he>פֵּירוּקָן בשעת וכ׳</he> the taking apart on moving the articles of the Tabernacle took place in the same order as they were put up.
